# Field models

Every field's `chara.one` in `extracted_files/field` and the models it holds, generated from the files on 2026-10-06.

- 873 fields, 7093 models: 5194 main-character entries (mesh in `field/model/main_chr`, animations in the field) and 1899 NPC models (stored in the field).
- **#** is the model id the field script uses (SETMODEL). **Name** is the 4-character model name stored in chara.one (`dNNN` main characters, `pNNN`/`nNNN`/`oNNN`… NPCs and objects); `modelN` when the file stores none.
- **Dialogue name**: the speaker names (first line of a dialogue box, e.g. "Trepe Groupie #1") of the messages shown by the entities using this model in that field — the in-game name. "—" = no named message. 1606 of the 7093 models have one. Text variables show as `{Squall}`. Card-game messages shown by the shared `cardgamemaster` entities are not counted.
- **Used by**: the field's script entities (names from its .sym) that set this model with SETMODEL — the readable name of who the model is in that field. "—" = no entity of the script uses it. 7082 of the 7093 models have at least one.
- **Model file**: main characters load `dNNN.mch`; NPCs are stored in the chara.one.
- **Animations**: number of animations this field gives the model. Bones, vertices and faces come from the model data header (for main characters, from their .mch).
- Field id = line number in `mapdata/maplist`. 23 fields are not listed there, so the game never loads them.
